message: Ah, winter storms. They can be a bit of a nuisance, but I like to think of them as the universe’s way of giving us a cozy invitation to snuggle up at home. I found a useful resource that talks about how to prepare for these chilly days, so you can turn a potential hassle into an opportunity for hot cocoa and a good book. What's your favorite winter cozy-up activity? ☕️
